disclaimer: Modelled with illustrative effect sizes on real tide levels and FEMA flood-zone shares. A ranking of plans under three defined futures, not a flood forecast and not an engineering result.

futures.name: Ordinary coastal conditions
futures.note: A typical high tide: mean higher high water, 12.38 − 10.13 = 2.25 ft MLLW. No heavy rain.

futures.name: High tide + heavy rain
futures.note: NOAA's minor flood level, 14.07 − 10.13 = 3.94 ft MLLW, with a heavy rain event (3 in, illustrative).

futures.name: Extreme coastal flooding
futures.note: NOAA's major flood level, 16.27 − 10.13 = 6.14 ft MLLW, with extreme rain (6 in, illustrative).
